messages:
Priya K.: Quick sync: postmortem for KiteLabs uncovered cross-cutting remediation we should track centrally (Dedicated + On-Prem). Putting actions here to avoid duplication.
Sam H.: Thanks. Can you list the concrete problems?
Priya K.: Summary from PM: 
  - peering route propagation sometimes stale after recon (customer loses connectivity intermittently).
  - on-prem NAT/firewall timeouts causing apparent session drops.
  - autoscale race where instances bind an old route table briefly (isolation bug).
  - no automated verification after peering updates; manual checks are flaky.
Linh: For peering propagation we can add retry/backoff in the peering orchestration and a verification step that confirms route-table entries on the edge.
Marc: On the on-prem doc, customers vary a lot. We need a minimal firewall/NAT expectation doc and a Support-friendly test script.
Priya K.: Proposed owners:
  - Peering propagation + retry: Sam H.
  - Post-apply verify + alerts: Linh
  - On-prem firewall guidance + Support runbook: Marc & Ops-Jen
  - Autoscale route race triage: Priya K.
Sam H.: I'll draft a short RFC for retry logic and the metrics we should emit (propagation latency, failed applies). ETA: prototype in 2 sprints.
Ops-Jen: I'll coordinate Solutions and Support to capture vendor-specific quirks. We need a checklist: TCP idle timeout, conntrack size, asymmetric route guidance.
Linh: Verification plan (initial):
```
# verification pseudo-steps
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=vpc-id,Values=$VPC | jq '.RouteTables'
curl -fsS http://edge-health/kitelabs/peer-check || exit 1
```
Then fail the peering job and page if the route isn't present after N retries. Add an alert: `peer.propagation.failures > 1` in 15m.
Priya K.: Also requirement: every Dedicated/Private postmortem with networking impact must include a one-page Support test (commands + expected outputs) so Support can validate customer connectivity.
Marc: I'll draft the Support test template and upload to Confluence.
Sam H.: Should we track recurring isolation incidents as a metric? Maybe do a quarterly trends review for patterns across customers.
Priya K.: Agreed. I'll own the quarterly isolation trends review. Start next quarter.
oncall-bot: Incident 2026-03-12-KiteLabs marked RESOLVED by Sam H.  postmortem published.
Ops-Jen: Action items (I'll create Jira tickets and paste IDs here):
  - RI-PEER-RETRY  owner: Sam H.  add retry + verification
  - RI-PEER-VERIFY  owner: Linh  verification job + alerting + test endpoint
  - RI-ONPREM-RUNBOOK  owners: Marc, Ops-Jen  firewall checklist + Support test
  - RI-AUTOSCALE-ROUTE  owner: Priya K.  investigate route table binding race
Priya K.: SLAs: proposal/prototype 2 weeks, implementation 4-6 weeks, canary 1 sprint. If >8 weeks escalate to Eng leads.
Sam H.: RI-PEER-RETRY-1298 created, ETA 2026-04-01.
Linh: RI-PEER-VERIFY-4301 created, PR in progress behind feature flag.
Marc: RI-ONPREM-RUNBOOK-7722 created, working session scheduled next Wed.
Priya K.: RI-AUTOSCALE-ROUTE-5533 created, triage started.
Priya K.: Final checks before I close this thread: please confirm tickets + ETA, Ops to run Support test on KiteLabs staging once verify job is live, I'll send calendar invite for quarterly trends.
Sam H.: Confirmed.
Linh: Will ping when PR is up.
Marc: Uploaded runbook draft: https://redwood.internal/confluence/RI-ONPREM-RUNBOOK. Feedback welcome.
Priya K.: Thanks all. I'll mark this tracking thread closed after tickets show progress. :white_check_mark:
